text:
maya: Quick check — I'm planning to take the 11:30 release-train slot (region: us-west). Can someone confirm a smoke owner and a rollback partner?

kai: I can be smoke owner for the 11:30 window. Will be on standby 11:15-12:00 PT. :thumbsup:

loren: I can be rollback partner. ETA to respond to a rollback is ~10min.

sasha: FYI the db-migrations PR is still pending LGTM (ci/job: migrations/integration). If that doesn't land we should avoid the canary with schema changes.

maya: Good call. This deployment is only service + routing config (no migrations). PR is https://git.redwood/example/repo/pull/412. CI looks green for the last run.

kai: Confirmed. I'll run the smoke checklist:
```
- run smoke: ./scripts/smoke-check --slot 11:30
- validate endpoints: /health, /v1/generate
- tail logs for 5m: kubectl -n prod logs -l app=frontend -f --since=5m
```

al: Heads up — infra will be doing a short maintenance at 12:20 PT. If we expect any long rollout we should avoid starting after 11:45.

maya: Good to know. We'll aim to finish canary by 11:45 and then do 11:50 wide rollout if green.

loren: For rollback, I'll have the snapshot ready and the rollback playbook open: https://runbooks.redwood/release/rollback. If we hit >2% 5m error rate I'll flip the flag.

kai: ping @sasha — can you give the final LGTM on the PR by 11:10 so we can still squeeze a quick smoke earlier?

sasha: On it. Quick review pass done, left 1 tiny comment about a log line. Will approve by 11:05 if that comment looks fine.

maya: Thanks all. Final plan: start canary 11:30, smoke owner kai, rollback loren, wide rollout 11:50, finish by 12:10 latest. If infra maintenance blocks, abort wide rollout. I'll post a short update 11:25. :rocket:

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: train=1746504321 slot=11:30 owner=maya canary_job=release/canary-1746504321 status=scheduled

al: I'll put a note on the infra channel about the 12:20 maintenance so owners are aware.

maya: Awesome — thanks everyone. If anything changes, reply here and I'll adjust the timeline.
